post_study_proposals.proposal: Ensure primary computed variables are serialized as requested typed rows in the first numerical execution; separate successful table/file metadata from completeness of requested scientific quantities. Any future assembly must use actual structured evidence, preserve exact names/units, and never transcribe rounded stdout into uncomputed final rows.

post_study_proposals.proposal: Make actual execution role and independent-review state explicit in any final prose verification claim; a coder script called blind reviewer is still a coder execution.
